Display settings only. Nothing here is sent to a miner, and this page is reachable from the local network only. Both AxeOS variants trigger their own thermal protection at 70 °C, and the NerdQAxe fan controller targets 55 °C, so a critical level above 70 would turn the tile red only after the firmware had already stepped in.

MINERS

Add, edit or remove miners. Changes apply immediately — a newly added AxeOS miner is polled at once and shows offline until its hardware is on the network. Host is an IP or hostname (e.g. 192.168.1.51 or bitaxe.local).

DATA PROVIDERS

Base URLs for the Bitcoin network data and the solo pool. Leave as-is to use the defaults (mempool.space, public-pool.io). A self-hosted mempool instance can go here.

MONITORING

Switch a miner off to hide it from the dashboard and stop polling it. This only affects the monitor — the miner keeps mining.
